name: Bloody Tears and Jagged Smile
text:
**Bloody Tears and Jagged Smile**

**School** necromancy; **Level** arcanist 2, cleric 2, oracle 2, sorcerer 2, warpriest 2, wizard 2 (Szuriel)
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** personal and see text
**Target** you and see text
**Duration** 10 minutes/level
**Saving Throw** none; **Spell Resistance** yes

Your eyes turn black and weep blood, and your teeth become
 jagged fangs. You gain a bite attack (1d3 points of damage if
 you are Small, 1d4 points of damage if you are Medium). You
 gain a +4 profane bonus on Intimidate checks and on your spell
 DCs for spells with the fear descriptor. You perceive creatures as
 if using deathwatch.
